abstract: Yolk sac tumor (YST) is the most common form of malignant testicular tumor in infancy and children. However, there is no general agreement on its treatment regimen due to its rare occurrence. From 1978 through 1990, 30 cases of YST of the testis were treated at Chang Gung Children's Hospital. Thirteen (43.3%) occurred in the right testis and 17 (56.7%) in the left. Age at operation ranged from six months to five years with a mean of 1.79 years. All patients received an orchidectomy as their initial treatment. Eighteen patients with stage I disease were treated by orchidectomy alone. Fourteen (77.8%) of them were free of disease, two patients who had recurrence with retroperitoneal metastasis were successfully treated with chemotherapy. The remaining two patients died of metastasis. Seven patients with stage II disease and five with stage III disease were treated with combination chemotherapy, irradiation or debulking operation following orchidectomy. Four stage II patients (57.1%) and one stage III patient (20%) showed no evidence of disease at the time of follow-up. It was concluded that for stage I disease, orchidectomy alone followed by strict monitoring of alpha- fetoprotein achieved an 89% disease-free survival rate. Retroperitoneal node dissection or routine chemotherapy added no benefit to survival. For stage II or III disease, chemotherapy or irradiation is needed to obtain a better outcome.
abstract_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍（YST）は乳児および小児において最も頻度の高い悪性精巣腫瘍である。しかし、まれな疾患であるため、その治療方針については一定の合意が得られていない。1978年から1990年までに、長庚小児病院で精巣のYST 30例を治療した。43.3%（13例）が右精巣、56.7%（17例）が左精巣に発生した。手術時年齢は生後6か月から5歳、平均1.79歳であった。全患者が初回治療として精巣摘除術を受けた。病期I の18例は精巣摘除術のみで治療された。そのうち14例（77.8%）は無病生存し、後腹膜転移を伴う再発をきたした2例は化学療法により救命された。残る2例は転移により死亡した。病期II の7例と病期III の5例は、精巣摘除後に併用化学療法、放射線療法、または減量手術を受けた。病期IIの4例（57.1%）と病期IIIの1例（20%）は、フォローアップ時に疾患の証拠がなかった。病期Iでは、精巣摘除後に厳密なαフェトプロテイン(AFP)監視を行えば、89%の無病生存率が得られると結論された。後腹膜リンパ節郭清や定期的な化学療法は生存上の利益をもたらさなかった。病期IIまたはIIIでは、良好な転帰を得るために化学療法または放射線療法が必要である。
